prompts.planet:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game texture, full 360-degree planetary albedo map, 2:1 equirectangular layout.
Input image is a STYLE AND PALETTE reference for the approved planet, not a shape to preserve.
Generate ONLY a flat seamless full-bleed 2:1 rectangular world surface map for wrapping on a 3D sphere: deep teal blue oceans, several irregular muted sage/grey rocky continental island masses with recognisable varied coastlines, restrained turquoise shallow water edges and fine pale atmospheric cloud streaks. Quiet painterly natural detail, like the reference. The landforms should be readable when a whole globe is just 30 pixels wide, so use a few broad continents and some smaller islands. Fictional geography, not Earth.
Absolutely no globe, circle, sphere outline, vignette, rim, 3D lighting, shadows, sun, space background, glow, labels, text, frame, legend or watermark. This is an evenly lit/unlit albedo surface texture, the renderer supplies all globe shading. Fill the complete rectangular canvas edge to edge. Continuous texture at the left/right seam, polar terrain at top/bottom. Desired aspect ratio 2:1 landscape.
prompts.moon:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game texture, full 360-degree moon albedo map, 2:1 equirectangular layout.

A few asymmetrically placed medium-sized crater landmarks must read on a tiny moon. Match the natural restrained subtle detail of the reference.
Absolutely no globe, circle, sphere outline, vignette, rim, directional 3D lighting, cast shadows, sun, space background, glow, labels, text, frame, legend or watermark. Even albedo lighting; renderer supplies globe shading. Fill complete rectangular canvas edge to edge. Continuous left/right seam and subdued polar regions top/bottom. Desired aspect ratio 2:1 landscape.
prompts.star:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game texture, full 360-degree stellar surface detail map, 2:1 equirectangular layout.
Input image is a reference for the cellular granulation texture family.
Generate ONLY a flat seamless full-bleed 2:1 rectangular grayscale stellar photosphere texture map for wrapping on a 3D sphere. Fine organic convection cells like the reference, combined with a FEW broad gently darker irregular active regions and drifting bands so rotation is readable on a star just 30 pixels wide. Mid-grey to soft pale grey with restrained contrast. Not black holes. The activity should be nonuniform, beautiful and subtle, natural gaseous material, not a grid.
Absolutely no globe, sphere, circle, vignette, rim, directional lighting, gradient falloff, fiery prominences, flames, flares, bright flash, space background, sun icon, text, diagram, border, or watermark. No color: neutral grayscale only; the renderer supplies amber/cyan/coral and limb darkening. Fill full rectangular canvas. Continuous left/right seam. Desired aspect ratio 2:1 landscape.
